8	-- The two declarations this file's docstrings reason ABOUT rather than use:
9	-- `isCertified_affine_and_not_isCertified_chart` (the R2 strictness payoff, which is WHY the
10	-- widened carrier has to reach the Picard side at all) and `abelSigmaChart` (the consumer that
11	-- takes a CHART-TYPED representation, which is what it cannot currently reach). Imported so
12	-- every cited name is in this file's import closure and `#check`s here rather than merely
13	-- being greppable elsewhere -- measured on the first version of this header, which cited both
14	-- out of scope (the recurring failure recorded at I-1073).
15	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyAffStrict
16	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0AtlasFromDivRep
17	
18	/-!
19	# THE ABEL HOOK ON THE R2 CARRIER: `DivFamZarAff` acquires a Picard class in `picEt`
20	
21	Protection `I-0492` mandates the **widened** carrier — `DivFamZarAff`, certificates over
22	arbitrary affine-open covers — and `isCertified_affine_and_not_isCertified_chart`
23	(`Picard/DivisorFamilyAffStrict.lean`) proves the widening is *strict*: a straddling connected
24	divisor is certified on the widened side and on **no** chart-typed adaptation, in any degree.
25	
26	Measured at HEAD before writing this file (declaration index, plus a case-insensitive grep so
27	that producers in suffix position are not missed — memory `I-1005`): the widened carrier had a
28	class map (`DivFamZarAff.picClass`) and its two naturalities, a functor (`divFunctorAff`) and a
29	comparison (`divFunctorToAff`) — and **zero** declarations carrying it to `PicEtAff`, `picEt`,
30	`relPic` or `pic0`.  The whole Abel layer (`abelDivPlus`, `abelDivAff`, `abelDiv`,
31	`abelDivTrans`, `chartValue`, `DivFamZar.classDeg_picClass`) is stated at `DivFamZar` alone
32	(`Picard/DivSchemeAbel.lean`); of the 25 files mentioning `DivFamZarAff`, none composed it with
33	the unit of the plus construction.
34	
35	That gap is why the two halves of the DD-R lane cannot meet.  `abelSigmaChart`
36	(`Picard/Pic0AtlasFromDivRep.lean:205`) takes `rep : (divFunctor C π n).RepresentableBy D` — the
37	**chart-typed** functor — and composes it through `chartValueTrans`/`chartValue`/`abelDiv`.  So
38	the only Σ-atlas the tree can build is built from a representation of `divFunctor`, while the
39	carrier the human's decision mandates is `divFunctorAff`.  A widened representability datum,
40	had anyone one, could not have reached the atlas at all.
41	
42	## What this file lands, and what it does NOT
43	
44	It lands the Abel hook on the widened carrier: the composite
45	`PicEtAff.unit ∘ relPicMk ∘ DivFamZarAff.picClass`, its naturality in the test algebra, its
46	lift to an arbitrary test object through the widened vehicle, and naturality there.  Every step
47	is the chart-typed proof with `DivFamZarAff` in place of `DivFamZar`; nothing is new
48	mathematics, and that cheapness is the finding — the gap was a missing transcription, not a
49	missing theorem.
50	
51	**No certificate is produced and no gate is cleared.**  In particular this does *not* prove the
52	widened functor representable, does not discharge `rep` (antecedent 3 of
53	`pic0RepresentableByOfCharts`), and does not weaken the straddling no-go.  `π` is still carried
54	as a section variable everywhere the chart-typed statements carry it, because the *comparison*
55	`DivFamZar.toAff` needs it even though the widened carrier itself does not.
56	
57	## The compatibility that makes this consistent with the chart-typed layer
58	
59	`abelDivAffPlus_toAff` records that the widened hook applied to the image of a chart-typed
60	class is the chart-typed hook: the two Abel values agree, because `DivFamZarAff.picClass_toAff`
61	says the widening does not move the Picard class.  So this is an *extension* of the existing
62	Abel layer along `divFunctorToAff`, not a second incompatible one.
63	
64	## Main declarations
65	
66	* `AlgebraicGeometry.abelDivAffPlus` — the widened Abel transformation at an affine test.
67	* `AlgebraicGeometry.abelDivAffPlus_mapAlgHom` — its naturality in the test algebra.
68	* `AlgebraicGeometry.abelDivAffPlus_toAff` — agreement with the chart-typed hook.
69	* `AlgebraicGeometry.abelDivAff'` — the widened Abel transformation at an arbitrary test.
70	* `AlgebraicGeometry.picEtMap_abelDivAff'` — its naturality in the test object.
71	-/
72	
73	set_option autoImplicit false
74	/- Statements mix `Γ(relCurve C R, ·)` with opens produced on the product spelling; see
75	`AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.RelativeSectionsLinear`. -/
76	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
77	/- `lake env lean` drops the lakefile's `[leanOptions]` (I-0161), so the pinned synthesis depth
78	must be set in-file for the faithful per-file check. -/
79	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3

81	universe u

83	open CategoryTheory MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory Opposite
84	
85	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
86	
87	attribute [local instance] Over.sectionsAlgebra Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
88	
89	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))} [IsProper C.hom] {n : ℕ}
90	
91	noncomputable section
92	
93	/-! ## The widened Abel transformation at an affine test -/
94	
95	section AbelAff
96	
97	variable (C) in
98	/-- **The Abel transformation of a widened locally certified class at an affine test**: the
99	étale-unit image of the relative Picard class of `𝒪(F₀)`.
100	
101	Verbatim `abelDivPlus` (`Picard/DivSchemeAbel.lean`) with `DivFamZarAff` in place of
102	`DivFamZar` — the class map `DivFamZarAff.picClass` is all that is consumed, and it never saw
103	the cover, so no chart typing enters. -/
104	def abelDivAffPlus (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] (F₀ : DivFamZarAff C A n) :
105	    PicEtAff C A :=
106	  PicEtAff.unit C A (relPicMk C (overSpec k A) F₀.picClass)
107	
108	/-- **Naturality of the widened affine Abel transformation in the test algebra**
109	(`DivFamZarAff.picClass_mapAlg` + `PicEtAff.mapAlg_unit`): base change of the widened Abel
110	value is the Abel value of the base-changed class. -/
111	theorem abelDivAffPlus_mapAlgHom {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] [CommRing B]
112	    [Algebra k B] (φ : A →ₐ[k] B) (F₀ : DivFamZarAff C A n) :
113	    PicEtAff.mapAlg C φ (abelDivAffPlus C A F₀)
114	      = abelDivAffPlus C B (DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom φ F₀) := by
115	  letI : Algebra A B := φ.toRingHom.toAlgebra
116	  haveI : IsScalarTower k A B := .of_algebraMap_eq fun a => (φ.commutes a).symm
117	  have hclass : (DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom φ F₀).picClass
118	      = Scheme.CechPic.map (C ◁ Over.overSpecMap φ).left F₀.picClass := by
119	    have hcurve : relCurveMap C A B = (C ◁ Over.overSpecMap φ).left := by
120	      refine congrArg (fun ψ : overSpec k B ⟶ overSpec k A => (C ◁ ψ).left) ?_
121	      exact Over.OverMorphism.ext rfl
122	    rw [← hcurve]
123	    exact DivFamZarAff.picClass_mapAlg B n F₀
124	  calc PicEtAff.mapAlg C φ (abelDivAffPlus C A F₀)
125	      = PicEtAff.unit C B (relPicAlgMap C φ
126	          (relPicMk C (overSpec k A) F₀.picClass)) := PicEtAff.mapAlg_unit C φ _
127	    _ = PicEtAff.unit C B (relPicMk C (overSpec k B)
128	          (Scheme.CechPic.map (C ◁ Over.overSpecMap φ).left F₀.picClass)) :=
129	        congrArg (PicEtAff.unit C B)
130	          (relPicMap_mk C (Over.overSpecMap φ) F₀.picClass)
131	    _ = abelDivAffPlus C B (DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom φ F₀) := by
132	        rw [abelDivAffPlus, hclass]
133	
134	omit [IsProper C.hom] in
135	/-- **The widened hook extends the chart-typed one along `DivFamZar.toAff`**: the widened Abel
136	value of the image of a chart-typed class is the chart-typed Abel value.
137	
138	This is what makes the file an *extension* of `Picard/DivSchemeAbel.lean` rather than a second,
139	incompatible Abel layer: `DivFamZarAff.picClass_toAff` says the widening does not move the
140	Picard class, and both hooks are `unit ∘ relPicMk` of that class. -/
141	theorem abelDivAffPlus_toAff {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
142	    {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsAffineHom π] (F₀ : DivFamZar C A π n) :
143	    abelDivAffPlus C A F₀.toAff = abelDivPlus C π A F₀ := by
144	  rw [abelDivAffPlus, abelDivPlus, DivFamZarAff.picClass_toAff]
145	
146	end AbelAff
147	
148	/-! ## The widened Abel transformation at an arbitrary test -/
149	
150	section AbelVehicle
151	
152	/- `picEtMap` (`Picard/PicEtMap.lean:206-207`) carries these two beyond `[IsProper C.hom]`; they
153	are hypotheses of the whole DD-R lane, so this costs no generality, but they are stated rather
154	than inherited silently. -/
155	variable [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [GeometricallyReduced C.hom]
156	
157	variable (C n) in
158	/-- **The Abel transformation of a widened class at an arbitrary test object**: componentwise
159	over the affine opens of the test, compatible by `abelDivAffPlus_mapAlgHom`.
160	
161	Verbatim `abelDiv` (`Picard/DivSchemeAbel.lean`) on the widened vehicle. -/
162	def abelDivAff' (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) (s : divFamZarAff C n T) : picEt C T :=
163	  ⟨fun U => abelDivAffPlus C Γ(T.left, U.1) (s.1 U), fun U V h => by
164	    rw [abelDivAffPlus_mapAlgHom (Over.resAlgHom T h) (s.1 V), s.compat U V h]⟩
165	
166	omit [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [GeometricallyReduced C.hom] in
167	@[simp]
168	lemma abelDivAff'_val (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) (s : divFamZarAff C n T)
169	    (U : T.left.affineOpens) :
170	    (abelDivAff' C n T s).1 U = abelDivAffPlus C Γ(T.left, U.1) (s.1 U) :=
171	  rfl
172	
173	/-- **Naturality of the widened Abel transformation in the test object**: restriction of the
174	widened Abel value along an arbitrary test morphism is the widened Abel value of the restricted
175	family.
176	
177	The chart-typed proof (`picEtMap_abelDiv`) transported: both glued restrictions are pinned by
178	their `∃!`-characterizations, and the widened one is `divFamZarAff.mapVal_spec`. -/
179	theorem picEtMap_abelDivAff' {T T' : Over (Spec (.of k))} (f : T' ⟶ T)
180	    (s : divFamZarAff C n T) :
181	    picEtMap C f (abelDivAff' C n T s) = abelDivAff' C n T' (divFamZarAff.map C n f s) := by
182	  refine picEt.ext fun W => ?_
183	  rw [picEtMap_val]
184	  refine picEtMapVal_eq_of C f (abelDivAff' C n T s) ?_
185	  intro W₀ hW₀ V hV
186	  rw [abelDivAff'_val, abelDivAff'_val, divFamZarAff.map_val,
187	    abelDivAffPlus_mapAlgHom (Over.resAlgHom T' hW₀) (divFamZarAff.mapVal C n f s W),
188	    abelDivAffPlus_mapAlgHom (Over.appLEAlgHom f V.1 W₀.1 hV) (s.1 V),
189	    divFamZarAff.mapVal_spec C n f s W W₀ hW₀ V hV]
190	
191	end AbelVehicle
192	
193	/-! ## The widened chart value, and the ONE statement still owed
194	
195	`chartValue` (`Picard/DivSchemeAbel.lean`) twists the Abel value into degree zero, and its
196	`pic0Subgroup` membership is `degAt_chartValue` plus the chart-index degree constraint.  The
197	widened analogue of the twist is free — it is the same product in `picEt C T`, whose factors
198	`sigmaFamily`/`thetaFamily` never saw a divisor cover at all.  What is **not** free is the
199	degree ledger: `degAt_abelDiv` rests on `DivFamZar.classDeg_picClass`, whose proof runs through
200	the field collapse `DivFam.exists_toZar_eq` and the CRT identity `deg_divFamDivisor`, and the
201	degree half of that chain (`DivisorAdaptation.deg_presentationDivisor_eq_finrank_glued`) consumes
202	`relCover_sup` together with `cover₀`/`cover₁` — the pinned-pair structure R2 removes.
203	
204	Measured, not assumed: there is no widened analogue of `finrank_glued_eq_sum_of_separated`,
205	`subsingleton_ovlColength_of_sep`, `finrank_colength_eq_sum` or `coeffAt_eq_zero_of_isUnit_germ`
206	anywhere in the `DivisorFamilyAff*` family.  The widened `AffAdaptation` *does* carry the whole
207	module layer these would be about (`colength`, `ovlColength`, `gluedSubmodule`, `Glued`,
208	`IsCertified` clause for clause), so the obstruction is a missing transcription of the degree
209	argument, not a missing structure — but the transcription is not free, because the chart-typed
210	proof spends the two-chart covering where the widened one has only a joint `⨆ j, pieces j = ⊤`.
211	
212	So the degree ledger is stated below as an explicit hypothesis `hdegAff` on the widened Abel
213	transformation, at exactly the shape `degAt_abelDiv` has.  It is **not** discharged here, and it
214	is **not** hidden inside a class whose statement omits the objects: it mentions the curve, the
215	widened section, the field point and the degree.  A `sorry` would have been dishonest in the
216	other direction — this way the obligation appears in every consumer's signature. -/
217	
218	section ChartValueAff
219	
220	/- Beyond the vehicle's instances, the TWIST factors need the curve's geometry: `sigmaFamily`
221	and `thetaFamily` (`Picard/DivSchemeAbel.lean` §Sigma, `Picard/ThetaShift.lean`) carry
222	`[SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom]` and `[GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]`.  All are standing
223	DD-R hypotheses; they are named here rather than inherited. -/
224	variable [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [GeometricallyReduced C.hom]
225	  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom]
226	
227	variable (C n) in
228	/-- **The widened chart value**: the widened Abel value shifted by the Σ-family and `m` inverse
229	powers of the pinned θ-family — verbatim `chartValue` with `abelDivAff'` in place of `abelDiv`.
230	
231	The twist itself is cover-free: `sigmaFamily` and `thetaFamily` are built from Čech classes on
232	the base-changed curve and know nothing of a divisor cover, so the widening does not touch
233	them. -/
234	def chartValueAff (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
235	    (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) (s : divFamZarAff C n T) : picEt C T :=
236	  abelDivAff' C n T s * sigmaFamily C Z T
237	    * (thetaFamily C (thetaCechClass C) T ^ m)⁻¹
238	
239	variable (C n) in
240	/-- Naturality of the widened chart value in the test object — `picEtMap_abelDivAff'` together
241	with the two naturalities of the twist factors. -/
242	theorem picEtMap_chartValueAff (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
243	    {T T' : Over (Spec (.of k))} (f : T' ⟶ T) (s : divFamZarAff C n T) :
244	    picEtMap C f (chartValueAff C n m Z T s)
245	      = chartValueAff C n m Z T' (divFamZarAff.map C n f s) := by
246	  rw [chartValueAff, chartValueAff, map_mul, map_mul, map_inv, map_pow, picEtMap_abelDivAff',
247	    sigmaFamily_natural, thetaFamily_natural]
248	
249	omit [GeometricallyReduced C.hom] in
250	variable (C n) in
251	/-- **The widened chart value lands in `pic0`, GIVEN the widened degree ledger.**
252	
253	`hdegAff` is the widened form of `degAt_abelDiv` and it is the single statement this file does
254	not prove: *the widened Abel value of a degree-`n` widened class has degree `n` at every field
255	point*.  Read the dependency honestly — the chart-typed ledger goes through
256	`DivFamZar.classDeg_picClass`, whose degree half consumes the pinned-pair covering
257	(`relCover_sup`, `cover₀`/`cover₁`) that R2 deletes, so this is a genuine obligation and not
258	bookkeeping.
259	
260	Everything else in the degree-zero-ness argument transports unchanged: the three degrees still
261	sum to zero under the chart-index constraint, because the twist factors are cover-free. -/
262	theorem chartValueAff_mem_pic0Subgroup (m : ℕ)
263	    (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
264	    (hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k Z
265	      = (m : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C) - (n : ℤ))
266	    (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) (s : divFamZarAff C n T)
267	    (hdegAff : ∀ {K : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K] (t : overSpec k K ⟶ T),
268	      degAt (abelDivAff' C n T s) t = (n : ℤ)) :
269	    chartValueAff C n m Z T s ∈ pic0Subgroup C T := by
270	  rw [mem_pic0Subgroup_iff]
271	  intro K _ _ t
272	  rw [chartValueAff, degAt_mul, degAt_mul, degAt_inv, degAt_thetaFamily_pow,
273	    degAt_sigmaFamily, hdegAff t, hdeg]
274	  ring
275	
276	omit [GeometricallyReduced C.hom] in
277	/-- **The widened ledger holds on the image of a chart-typed class** — so the hypothesis of
278	`chartValueAff_mem_pic0Subgroup` is not vacuous: it is inhabited at every widened section that
279	comes from a chart-typed one, by `degAt_abelDiv` transported along `abelDivAffPlus_toAff`.
280	
281	This is deliberately *not* offered as evidence that the general ledger holds.  It says the
282	obligation has witnesses, which is what distinguishes a real hypothesis from an unsatisfiable
283	one; the open question is whether it holds for a widened class with no chart-typed preimage,
284	which is exactly the class the R2 widening exists to admit. -/
285	theorem degAt_abelDivAff'_toAff {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite π]
286	    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (s : divFamZar C π n T) {K : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K]
287	    (t : overSpec k K ⟶ T) :
288	    degAt (abelDivAff' C n T (divFamZarToAffVehicle C n π s)) t = (n : ℤ) := by
289	  have hval : abelDivAff' C n T (divFamZarToAffVehicle C n π s) = abelDiv C π n T s := by
290	    refine picEt.ext fun U => ?_
291	    rw [abelDivAff'_val, abelDiv_val, divFamZarToAffVehicle_val, abelDivAffPlus_toAff]
292	  rw [hval, degAt_abelDiv]
293	
294	end ChartValueAff
295	
296	end
297	
298	end AlgebraicGeometry

/-- On an affine test the vehicle-level Abel transformation is the affine one, through
the comparison equivalences. -/
theorem abelDiv_overSpec (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    (s : divFamZar C π n (overSpec k A)) :
    abelDiv C π n (overSpec k A) s
      = abelDivAff C π A (divFamZarAffineEquiv C π n A s) :=
  (picEtAffineEquiv C A).injective

/-- **Naturality of the Abel transformation in the test object**: restriction of the
Abel value along an arbitrary test morphism is the Abel value of the restricted
family — through the `∃!`-characterizations of both glued restrictions. -/
theorem picEtMap_abelDiv {T T' : Over (Spec (.of k))} (f : T' ⟶ T)
    (s : divFamZar C π n T) :
    picEtMap C f (abelDiv C π n T s) = abelDiv C π n T' (divFamZar.map C π n f s) := by
  refine picEt.ext fun W => ?_
  rw [picEtMap_val]
  refine picEtMapVal_eq_of C f (abelDiv C π n T s) ?_
  intro W₀ hW₀ V hV
  rw [abelDiv_val, abelDiv_val, divFamZar.map_val,
    abelDivPlus_mapAlgHom (Over.resAlgHom T' hW₀) (divFamZar.mapVal C π n f s W),
    abelDivPlus_mapAlgHom (Over.appLEAlgHom f V.1 W₀.1 hV) (s.1 V),
    divFamZar.mapVal_spec C π n f s W W₀ hW₀ V hV]

/-! ## The degree ledger -/

/-- **The degree ledger** (worksheet §4.2): the Abel value of a degree-`n` family has
degree `n` at every field point — naturality reduces to the affine collapse at the
field, `degAff_unit` + `relPicDeg_relPicMk` read the class degree, and the field-level
degree law finishes. -/
theorem degAt_abelDiv {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (s : divFamZar C π n T) {K : Type u}
    [Field K] [Algebra k K] (t : overSpec k K ⟶ T) :
    degAt (abelDiv C π n T s) t = (n : ℤ) := by
  haveI : IsIntegral (relCurve C K) := instIsIntegralBaseChange C K
  haveI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (relCurve C K ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) :=
    instSmoothOfRelativeDimensionBaseChange C K
  haveI : QuasiCompact (relCurve C K ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) :=
    instQuasiCompactBaseChange C K
  haveI : Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C K).moduleKSheaf K) 0) :=
    instModuleFiniteHModuleZeroBaseChange C K
  haveI : Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C K).moduleKSheaf K) 1) :=
    instModuleFiniteHModuleOneBaseChange C K
  change PicEtAff.degAff K (picEtAffineEquiv C K
      (picEtMap C t (abelDiv C π n T s))) = (n : ℤ)
  rw [picEtMap_abelDiv, picEtAffineEquiv_abelDiv]
  change PicEtAff.degAff K (PicEtAff.unit C K (relPicMk C (overSpec k K)
      (divFamZarAffineEquiv C π n K (divFamZar.map C π n t s)).picClass)) = (n : ℤ)
  rw [PicEtAff.degAff_unit, relPicDeg_relPicMk]
  exact DivFamZar.classDeg_picClass _

variable (C π n) in
/-- **The Abel natural transformation into the degree-`n` layer** (the sharpened
dat-d Addendum row, worksheet §4.2): the Abel transformation, ledgered by
`degAt_abelDiv`, as a natural transformation
`divFunctor C π n ⟶ picDegLayerFunctor C n`. -/
def abelDivTrans : divFunctor C π n ⟶ picDegLayerFunctor C (n : ℤ) where
  app T := ↾fun s => ⟨abelDiv C π n T.unop s, fun K _ _ t => degAt_abelDiv s t⟩
  naturality T T' g := by
    ext s
    refine Subtype.ext ?_
    exact (picEtMap_abelDiv g.unop s).symm

@[simp]
lemma abelDivTrans_app_coe (T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ) (s : divFamZar C π n T.unop) :
    ((abelDivTrans C π n).app T s).1 = abelDiv C π n T.unop s :=
  rfl

/-- **The field-level degree law of the Abel ledger** (worksheet §4.2, bottom rows):
the Čech Picard class of a locally certified divisor class of degree `n` over a field
has `classDeg = n` — E-i (`classDeg_picClass`) composed with the CRT degree identity
(`deg_divFamDivisor`) on a globally certified representative. -/
theorem DivFamZar.classDeg_picClass
    [IsIntegral (relCurve C K)]
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (relCurve C K ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
    [QuasiCompact (relCurve C K ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
    [Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C K).moduleKSheaf K) 0)]
    [Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C K).moduleKSheaf K) 1)]
    (F₀ : DivFamZar C K π n) :
    classDeg K F₀.picClass = (n : ℤ) := by
  obtain ⟨G, rfl⟩ := DivFam.exists_toZar_eq F₀
  rw [DivFamZar.picClass_toZar]
  induction G using Quotient.inductionOn with
  | h F =>
    calc classDeg K (DivFam.picClass (DivFam.mk F))
        = classDeg K F.eqns.presentation.picClass := by
          rw [DivFam.picClass_mk, Scheme.LocalEquations.presentation_picClass]
      _ = classDeg K (Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass K
            (Scheme.presentationDivisor K F.eqns.presentation)) := by
          rw [Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass_presentationDivisor]
      _ = Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg K (Scheme.presentationDivisor K F.eqns.presentation) :=
          _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.classDeg_picClass K _
      _ = (n : ℤ) := by
          rw [show Scheme.presentationDivisor K F.eqns.presentation
              = divFamDivisor (DivFam.mk F) from (divFamDivisor_mk F).symm]
          exact deg_divFamDivisor (DivFam.mk F)
